items.headline: Citigroup Maintains Buy on EyePoint, Lowers Price Target to $17

items.headline: These Analysts Slash Their Forecasts On EyePoint
items.summary: EYPT releases topline results from Phase 3 LUGANO trial for wet AMD treatment. While primary endpoint was not met, secondary endpoints showed progress. Analysts adjust price targets.

items.headline: EyePoint: Still A Sell After Phase 3 Crash
items.summary: EyePoint, Inc. is rated a Sell, citing unfavorable risk/reward and concerns about commercial relevance against standard-of-care. Read more on EYPT stock here.

items.headline: EyePoint: Sell-Off As Duravyu Fails Head-To-Head Study Vs Eylea May Be Overblown
items.summary: Eyepoint Pharmaceuticals (EYPT) plunged ~70% after its LUGANO Phase 3 trial for Duravyu in wet AMD failed the primary endpoint due to an anomalous cohort.
